title: P2: Local Development Environment Grounding (bd+Dolt+Rails)
description: Second Planning round. Get a working local dev environment where bin/dev boots Fizzy AND Beads+Dolt is reachable from the Rails process. Critical research item per CEO Q7d. notes: P2 started by fizzy-codex. Next: run bin/setup + boot bin/dev + prove Rails↔Beads connectivity (CLI + if possible Dolt SQL), then write skills/local-dev.md + llm/notes/p2-local-dev-grounding.md.

title: P1: Foundational Gap Inventory — Fizzy ↔ Beads
